update.helper.legacy_helper.other: The running isolation helper predates safe upgrade guards. During a maintenance window, pause new submissions, wait for sessions to finish, stop the helper, run amux update, then start it again. Subsequent updates are automatic.

update.helper.failed.other: Isolation helper update failed; the amux binaries may already be updated. Resolve the reported cause and retry amux update.

update.helper.privilege_failed.other: Could not run the isolation helper update with administrator privileges. Noninteractive sudo is required; ask an administrator to grant it or update the helper, then retry amux update.

update.helper.busy.other: Isolation helper update blocked by %d active launch(es). Existing sessions continue; retry amux update after they finish.

update.helper.unchanged.other: Isolation helper and materializer are already up to date.

update.helper.updated.other: Updated the isolation helper and materializer; existing isolation settings were preserved.

update.helper.bundle_missing.other: This update bundle did not install an isolation helper binary. Retry using a complete matching release bundle.

update.helper.invalid_unit.other: The installed helper unit is not in the supported managed format; ask an administrator to update it.

update.helper.invalid_source.other: Use an absolute path to a complete release bundle.

update.helper.custom_unit.other: A custom service unit or systemd drop-in is present; an administrator must update the helper while preserving that configuration.

update.helper.service_transition.other: The helper service is starting or stopping; retry after it settles.

update.helper.invalid_target.other: The installed helper directory must be a root-owned directory without symlinks or group/other write access.

update.helper.upgrade_locked.other: Another helper update is running; retry after it finishes.
